runtime: Panoramas and foliage load asynchronously once and are reused by CPU/GPU rendering. Missing or undecodable images retain the procedural fallback and do not alter collision/road sampling. Generated landscapes serve as distant scenery only.
verification: All four panorama files were decoded successfully, capped to 1280 by 640 in the Node GPU-material binding check, and bound to sky uniforms. A simulated decode failure retained the procedural fallback. The actual browser GPU shader/render path and physical mobile-device frame rate were not observed in this environment.
